concerns.text: FR-001 (and FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, FR-007) reference '(See US-1)' etc., but no identifiers named US-1, US-2, US-3 exist in the document; the user stories are titled 'User Story 1', 'User Story 2', 'User Story 3'. This breaks traceability and creates undefined cross‑references.

Inconsistent terminology: the document uses both 'User Story 1' headings and the shorthand 'US-1' in FR cross‑references. Choose a single naming convention (e.g., label the stories as US-1, US-2, US-3) and keep it consistent throughout.
